files.title: File:Middletown Bridge deck looking eastward.jpg
files.author: Nyttend
files.caption: Looking eastward atop the Middletown Bridge, which carries the old route of Michigan Road over Conn's Creek just northwest of Middletown in Liberty Township, Shelby County, Indiana, United States.  Built in 1903, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
